description:
FILED s473t5c (#1501 round 4, `comp/` CHECK 2).  PRE-EXISTING; this is the
CAUSE two whole `comp/` files sit behind, measured on this tree.

perl's `$^P` (the debugger flag word) makes the compiler KEEP each compiled
file's and each string eval's source, as:
  * `@{"_<FILENAME"}`  -- element N is line N (element 0 is undef);
  * `${"_<FILENAME"}`  -- the file's name, writable;
  * `%{"_<FILENAME"}`  -- breakpoints, and `$^P & 0x2` keeps `do FILE`/`require`
    sources, `0x8`/`0x10`/`0x800`/`0x1000` the eval/anon-sub variants.
The names are stash entries, so the feature also needs #292's live
symbol-table half to be visible.

WHAT IT COSTS (measured, `tools/run-perl-suite.pl --jobs 1`, this tree):
  t/comp/line_debug.t   DIFF 1/24  -- ALL 24 of its fail rows.  The file is
      `$^P = 0x2; do "comp/line_debug_0.aux";` and then asserts
      `scalar(@{"_<comp/line_debug_0.aux"}) == 1+$nlines` and one row per
      source line.  Its 1 passing row is the `1..N` plan echo.
  t/comp/retainedlines.t  DIFF 18/91 -- ALL 91.  Clusters:
      `Line N is correct` x59, `N new eval` x9, `Right number of lines for …`
      x8, plus the `#line 42 "foo"` / BEGIN-dies / UNITCHECK-dies singles.
      The file sets `$^P = 0xA`, evals programs, and reads
      `grep { /eval/ } keys %::` to find the retained arrays.
  Neither file is an early stopper: both produce every row perl plans, so this
  is 115 honest row-level failures and no shortfall.

NOT a not-supported candidate as filed: this is a real perl feature with a
real implementation path here, since the transpiler HAS the source text at the
only moment that matters.  A sketch, for whoever sizes it:
  * the file case is a load-time emission -- `pl2cl` already reads the whole
    source, so a `$^P & 0x2`-gated preamble could populate the array under the
    file's own name;
  * the eval case is the one that needs care: the ARRAY must appear under
    `(eval N)` with perl's own counter, and `#line NAME` directives inside the
    eval re-home it (retainedlines.t tests exactly that);
  * `${"_<FOO"}` must be writable without breaking retention (its row 109).
The cheap partial -- the file half alone -- answers line_debug.t's 24 rows and
none of retainedlines.t's.

RELATED, NOT THE SAME: `caller()` filename/line (not-supported.md, DEFERRED)
is a different mechanism; #292 (live stash) gates the visibility of the names.
subject: The debugger's source retention (`$^P`, `@{"_<FILE"}`, `${"_<FILE"}`) does not exist -- t/comp/line_debug.t 24 rows and t/comp/retainedlines.t 91 rows are behind it
